# SGOU Academic Database
> Academic repository for Sree Narayana Guru Open University (SGOU / SNGOU), Kollam, Kerala.
> Curated and developed by Researcher Tizar.

## Overview
The SGOU Academic Database (https://sgou-database.vercel.app/) is a modern, client-side digital repository providing free, open access to university syllabus materials for distance education students:
- **1,200+ Course Self-Learning Material (SLM) Textbooks**
- **950+ Previous Year Exam Question Papers (PYQ)**
- **75+ Assignment Question Booklets**
- Covers all 37 programmes across FYUG (Four Year Undergraduate), UG, and PG levels.

## Key University Identifiers
- **Institution**: Sree Narayana Guru Open University (SNGOU / SGOU)
- **Location**: Kollam, Kerala, India
- **University Website**: https://sgou.ac.in
- **Platform URL**: https://sgou-database.vercel.app/

## Degree Programs Covered
- **FYUG / UG Disciplines**: Bachelor of Arts (B.A.) in English, Malayalam, Hindi, Sanskrit, Arabic, Economics, History, Sociology, Philosophy; Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com); Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA); Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA).
- **PG Disciplines**: Master of Arts (M.A.) in English, Malayalam, Hindi, Sanskrit, Arabic, Economics, History, Sociology, Philosophy; Master of Commerce (M.Com); Master of Social Work (MSW).

## Architecture & Technical Capabilities
- **Platform Type**: Progressive Web Application (PWA) with full offline caching.
- **Search Capabilities**: Instant multi-token full-text search across courses, course codes (e.g., B21CA01, B21EG01), question papers, and assignments.
- **Download Engine**: Streaming edge proxy bypassing payload limits and CORS restrictions.
- **Standalone Document Viewer**: https://sgou-database.vercel.app/view.html

## Key Links & API Resources
- Web Application: https://sgou-database.vercel.app/
- SLM Textbook Dataset: https://sgou-database.vercel.app/data/sgou_slm_data.json
- Question Paper & Assignment Dataset: https://sgou-database.vercel.app/data/sgou_questions_cleaned.json
- Standalone Viewer: https://sgou-database.vercel.app/view.html
- Developer / Curator: Researcher Tizar (researchertizar)
